name: digital-dm-screen
description: A tiling digital DM screen for tabletop RPGs
author: Travus
//license: Split on purpose — the code is mine, the SRD text under src/renderer/src/data/ is not. See LICENSE.md.
//homepage: Required by the .deb target. Point this at the real repo when there is one.

scripts.//check: The one command to run before pushing. CI runs the three parts separately, so a failure names itself.
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.//publish: --publish never on every dist target. electron-builder otherwise starts publishing the moment it detects CI and dies on a missing GH_TOKEN. Releases are cut by `gh release create` in release.yml, which uploads explicit assets to a draft; electron-builder must never touch GitHub. This only bit the macOS job, because the Linux/Windows build runs through docker compose, which does not forward CI into the container — the mac job runs natively, where it does.
scripts.//dist:mac: Gated rather than trusted: run either mac target in the Docker toolchain and electron-builder gets as far as the DMG before dying on a missing `sips`, which names neither the cause nor the fix. Both targets call the guard explicitly — npm's pre* hooks would only cover one of them.
scripts.dist:mac:host: node -e "if (process.platform !== 'darwin') { console.error('dist:mac must run on macOS: the DMG step needs sips, and a cross-built bundle is invalid. See CLAUDE.md.'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.dist:mac: npm run dist:mac:host && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:adhoc: npm run dist:mac:host && npm run build && electron-builder --publish never --mac dmg --arm64 -c.mac.identity=- -c.mac.entitlements=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist -c.mac.entitlementsInherit=build/entitlements.mac.adhoc.plist

//pinned.vite: Held at 7.x — electron-vite 5 peers on vite ^5 || ^6 || ^7.
//pinned.@vitejs/plugin-react: Held at 5.x — 6.x requires vite 8, which electron-vite 5 rejects.
//pinned.zustand: Held at 4.x — v5 dropped the useStore(selector, equalityFn) overload the initiative/party sync uses.
//pinned.react: Held at 18.x — nothing here needs 19, and the upgrade buys no fixes we care about.
//pinned.typescript: Held at 5.x — 7.x is the native rewrite; not worth the risk for this project yet.
